category_title: Preschoolers exhibiting physical aggression such as hitting, pushing, and kicking peers
minimal_context: The student is playing in the park with friends in the sand area.
dialogue:
TUTOR: We are playing in the park now. Go ahead and play in the sand with your friends.

STUDENT: (Runs over to the sand area and pushes a friend out of the way)

TUTOR: Let's try to play together.

STUDENT: No! (Hits the friend who tries to sit next to him)

TUTOR: What is happening over there?

STUDENT: (Kicks the friend and starts throwing sand and stones at them)

options.A: Ask the student how they would feel if they faced the same behavior to prompt empathy and reflection on the feelings of others.
options.B: Sit next to the student in the sand, use a toy to engage in physical play, stroke their back, and hold their hand.
options.C: Move close to the student and reinforce their correct play in the sand; at the same time, prompt them to notice if a friend is playing before taking a turn.
options.D: Give the student a hug and tell them that they are a lovely person and will soon find friends to play with in the park.
